_doc: Sprint 8 effect-extraction receipts. Each strict A-core record gets one receipt. Pooling reads only receipts that pass validate_extraction(); the rest are documented extraction failures.

evidence_quotes: The median lifespan of untreated mice is 7.8 months and median lifespan of the Rapatar-treated mice is 11.5 months, thus the treatment increased the median lifespan by 50%.
31 Bmal1−/− mice (both genders) were treated with rapatar and 73 Bmal1−/− mice (both genders) treated with control solution were used for the longevity experiment.
